summary: Adds the planned dashboard capability inventory.package.transform (action stock_package_transform): a signed, reviewed repack between two existing PACKAGED_STOCK balances of the same Store/Product/variant. Only the source quantity is drafted; the target quantity is derived exactly (source × sourceFactor ÷ targetFactor at the target scale, no rounding) and refused when not representable. Review binds both balance identities/revisions, units/factors/scales, the configuration version and quantities. Confirmation locks the Store then both sorted balances and calls the extracted canonical transformPackagedStockInTransaction; the native wrapper is unchanged.

capabilities.note: Owner/Admin/Manager per manifest policy; local and central access mirror assertCanManageInventory including scoped staff with the Store stock action. Dashboard only; no mobile, no linked loss adjustment.

procedures.reason: Canonical packaged-stock transformation used by inventory.package.transform through the extracted in-transaction seam.
